messages:
sam: RFC follow-up: lightweight per-request fence + retry assurance to safely resume streaming retries without global idempotency. sketch below.

marta: sounds useful. main risk is state growth per-tenant.

sam: agreed; keep fence record tiny (id, owner_session, last_seq, commit_flag). short idle TTL (5s) + small grace window for quick reconnects.

aj: client flow: send X-RW-Fence: <uuid>. proxy bind -> session. on reconnect proxy checks fence or verifies RAT (Retry Assurance Token) to decide ALLOW/SHORT_CIRCUIT/FORBID.

nina: long lived streams? allow X-RW-Fence-Live with operator caps & replication; default stays ephemeral.

kevin: backend needs to emit a commit hook so proxy can mint RAT. RAT is signed, timebound, and encodes outcome class, not internals.

marta: evictions: LRU per-tenant, prefer CLOSED fences. evicting ACTIVE -> FORBID. surface metrics: fence.create/resume_forbidden/eject_active.

aj: cross-region: prefer session affinity; if fence state not replicated, fall back to FORBID. offer opt-in strongly-replicated mode for customers who need global resume.

sam: operator config (example): default_idle_ms=5000, grace_ms=1500, tenant_max_active=100, global_soft=15000.

kevin: tests: quick reconnect, backend-commit-before-reconnect (short-circuit), metadata-lost -> forbid, eviction under churn.

deploy-bot: staging canary: fence.bind_success=842 fence.resume_allowed=31 fence.resume_forbidden=2

sam: I'll open PR for proxy bookkeeping + RAT sign/verify and small backend contract note. tagging @marta @aj for review; leaving open 48h.
